scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Glycerol viscosity
experiments.focus: Compare a thick liquid with water in the classroom model.
student_observations: It can look clear but feel thicker in the model.
experiments.teacher_note: Use this to introduce viscosity and mixing behavior.

experiments.title: Starch mixture idea
experiments.focus: Show that not every solid makes a truly clear solution.
student_observations: Some particles remain visible at first.
experiments.teacher_note: A good contrast with sugar dissolving examples.

experiments.title: Solution versus mixture
experiments.focus: Compare a dissolving sugar with a cloudier starch mixture.
student_observations: One sample stays clearer than the other.
The substances behave differently in water.
experiments.teacher_note: This is a classroom classification activity.
